You need to rebuild `/sessions/stoic-relaxed-carson/mnt/outputs/interactive-mockup.html` with two major changes: ## TASK 1: Add "Design Compare" as the FIRST tab The file at `/sessions/stoic-relaxed-carson/mnt/outputs/design-compare.html` contains a 160-card visual comparison document (20 sections, 8 cards each). You need to add this as the very first tab in the interactive mockup, BEFORE the existing tabs. Read the design-compare.html file and embed its body content as a new tab. The tab button should say "Design Compare" and be the first/default active tab. Key points: - The design-compare.html has its own top bar and mobile menu — DON'T include those (the interactive mockup already has tab navigation) - Extract everything inside the `
...
` from design-compare.html (the page title, subtitle, all 20 sections with their grids of option cards) - Include the part-divider between landing and results sections - Prefix/scope the design-compare CSS classes so they don't conflict (the classes are: .section, .section-title, .section-note, .grid, .oc, .cl, .cp, .cm, .t, .tc, .t1-.t5, .part-divider) - The design-compare content should NOT be affected by the floating control panel's CSS variable changes — it should remain static - Make sure all 20 sections with their 8 cards each render correctly ## TASK 2: Fix ALL styling to match the real site exactly Here are the EXACT computed styles from the real site that the mockup must match: ### Landing/Access Code Page: - **Main heading "Built for IB recruiting."**: Playfair Display, 62px, weight 400, line-height 57.66px, letter-spacing -1.55px, color rgb(243,241,236) - **"Unfiltered."**: Inter (NOT a serif font — it's just italic Inter), 62px, weight 400, italic, color rgb(201,169,110) / #C9A96E - **Body/subtitle text**: Inter, various sizes, color varies - **Access card**: bg semi-transparent black (lab with 0.8 opacity), border-radius 12px, 1px solid rgb(26,26,26) border, 24px padding, width 420px - **"Enter your access code" heading**: Playfair Display, 34px, weight 400 - **Continue button**: bg #C9A96E, color rgb(17,17,17), border-radius **6px** (NOT 12px!), font Inter, font-size 12.5px, font-weight 600 - **Input fields**: bg rgb(11,11,11), border-radius **6px**, 1px solid rgb(38,38,38) border, font-size 13px, padding 0 16px - **Labels ("ACCESS CODE", "EMAIL")**: font-size 10px, font-weight 600, letter-spacing 0.12em, uppercase, color rgb(161,161,161) - **Ticker bar**: bank names in uppercase, small text, scrolling animation - **Stats ("18+", "14+", "100")**: bold numbers with uppercase labels below ### Upload/About/Banks Pages: - Step indicator: 3 horizontal bars at top right of nav - **"Upload your resume" / "About you" / "Target banks"**: Playfair Display serif heading - **Nav bar**: bg rgb(14,14,13), height 49px, 1px solid rgb(42,40,38) bottom border - **"IB Resume BA" logo**: "IB Resume" in one weight, "BA" in gold accent (Inter font) - Upload zone: gold/accent colored dashed border - Form fields: same style as access code inputs (6px radius, dark bg, subtle border) - Bank pills: rounded chips with subtle borders - **"Analyze my resume →" button**: gold filled, same as Continue button style ### Results Page: - **Score circle**: Shows "95" inside a conic-gradient green ring (circle shape) - **"INTERVIEW-READY" badge**: green background, uppercase, small text - **Category bars**: FORMAT 15/15, EDUCATION 15/15, etc. — green filled progress bars with labels - **Section headers ("CRITICAL FIXES", "BANK FIT ANALYSIS")**: Inter, 12px, weight 600, letter-spacing 0.96px, uppercase - **Issue cards**: dark card background, left border accent color for warnings - **"Pass" badges**: small green pill badges - **Sidebar cards**: dark card backgrounds with section headers - **Export PDF / Re-upload buttons**: outlined style in the nav bar - **Checklist items**: green checkmark icon + item name + "Pass" badge on same row - **Before → After**: strikethrough red text for old, green text for new - **Bullet Rewriter**: "ORIGINAL" and "IB-OPTIMIZED VERSION" sections ### Critical Style Fixes: 1. Button border-radius should be **6px** not 12px 2. Input border-radius should be **6px** not 12px 3. "Unfiltered." should use **italic Inter** (same font as body), NOT a serif — the gold color is what makes it special 4. Main heading should be **62px** not smaller 5. Card border should be **1px solid** subtle, not just background color change 6. Nav height should be **49px** with bottom border 7. Section headers on results should be **12px uppercase Inter with 0.96px letter-spacing** 8. All form labels should be **10px uppercase with 0.12em letter-spacing** ## TASK 3: Make the floating control panel style changes robust The user reported "lots of the style things break." Make sure: - Each control dropdown change applies cleanly without leaving artifacts from previous selections - Button style changes properly reset ALL button properties before applying new ones - Progress bar style changes reset height, border-radius, and background - Score circle changes reset width, height, border-radius, border, and font properties - Badge changes reset background, border, border-radius, and padding - Issue card changes reset all border properties and box-shadow - Add a "Reset All" button at the top of the control panel that reverts everything to defaults ## IMPORTANT IMPLEMENTATION NOTES: - Read the existing file first to understand the structure - Read design-compare.html to extract the content for the first tab - The design compare tab content should be wrapped in a container that is NOT affected by CSS variable changes - Write the complete rebuilt file — don't try to do surgical edits on 2000+ lines - Keep all the Google Fonts that are already loaded - Make sure the tab switching JS handles the new tab - File should be at: `/sessions/stoic-relaxed-carson/mnt/outputs/interactive-mockup.html`
